query:
SELECT i.companyBoilerplate, i.keyChallenges, i.targetOrgSize, i.targetIndustries, i.technologyType
FROM intakeSubmissions i
WHERE i.sponsorId = 750001
ORDER BY i.submittedAt DESC
LIMIT 1;
